race.description: Eden Tyrepower Country Boosted Mdn Plate
race.comment: THIS AIN'T TEXAS (9) wasn't far away fresh before bumping into a smart one last start at this track and trip. She was best of the rest there however and should be primed for a bold run third-up. They choose to run here rather than later in the card and it could prove the winning move. THURSAIN (10) has moved to the Backhouse stable after finishing 2.4L off the winner at Grafton in November when racing under Kris Lees. The form she brings here stacks right up and she wouldn't have to do much different on resumption for the new stable. Can make an immediate impact. DANCING MUMMA (5) will be fitter for a recent trial and wasn't far away in what ended up being a good form race through Gundagai's carnival last year. Can feature in the finish. REMY'S BRO (4) was solid when behind THIS AIN'T TEXAS first-up, jumping favourite there. Include. FAMILY VISION (1) can feature on debut after a solid trial coming in.
